title: Zava renewal notice practice
subtitle: Keep source wording separate from questions for counsel

company.name: Zava Athletic Supply
company.description: Zava Athletic Supply and Vellum Kite Services are invented training organizations. All parties are fictional.

narrative.role: A fictional operations coordinator preparing a source-grounded review
narrative.situation: An invented agreement says: "Either fictional party may decline renewal by giving 45 days of written notice."
narrative.trigger: A fictional email says: "Please keep the notice wording unchanged while we collect questions for counsel."

through_line.name: Renewal review note
through_line.description: A running note separating source wording from interpretation.

files.purpose: Invented agreement wording for Zava Athletic Supply and Vellum Kite Services
An invented request to preserve the agreement wording

steps: Create the Renewal review note with Source wording and Questions for counsel headings.
ground_rules: All parties are fictional. Use only these invented practice materials.
Keep quoted wording unchanged and separate it from interpretation.

modes.name: Chat
modes.description: Compare the fictional wording before editing the note.

chapters.title: Capture the wording
chapters.story_so_far: The fictional coordinator needs a traceable source record.
chapters.you_will_add: The clause and the email sentence, unchanged

steps.title: Read the notice clause
steps.intro: The invented clause mentions 45 days; preserve the wording rather than calculating a deadline.

prompts.label: Extract the source
prompts.text: From renewal-terms.txt, copy Section 2.1 exactly into the Source wording heading of the Renewal review note. Include the section number and distinguish the source sentence from any interpretation.

expected.summary: The section number and sentence match the fictional source.

key_facts.text: Either fictional party may decline renewal by giving 45 days of written notice.

steps.carries_forward: Copy the checked sentence into "Source wording" in the Renewal review note.

callouts.text: Practice exercise, not professional advice. Verify wording against the invented source.

steps.title: Keep the request distinct
steps.goal: Capture the email request without changing the clause.
steps.uses: renewal-email.txt and the Renewal review note
steps.intro: The email asks for a faithful record, not a legal conclusion.

prompts.label: Add the email sentence
prompts.text: Read renewal-email.txt and copy its request verbatim beneath the clause in the Source wording heading. Label it as email wording, not as a term of the agreement.

expected.summary: The email wording remains distinct from the agreement.

key_facts.text: Please keep the notice wording unchanged while we collect questions for counsel.

steps.carries_forward: Add the email sentence under the "Source wording" heading.

chapters.title: Prepare questions, not conclusions
chapters.story_so_far: The note holds unchanged wording from the invented sources.
chapters.you_will_add: Questions for counsel and a checked handoff

steps.title: Questions for counsel
steps.goal: Turn interpretations into questions for an expert.
steps.uses: renewal-terms.txt and the Renewal review note
steps.intro: Keep plain text and interpretation in separate parts of the note.

prompts.label: Prepare questions
prompts.text: Review the Source wording heading in the Renewal review note. Turn each interpretation or uncertainty into a question for counsel under Questions for counsel. Separate what the clause actually says from what an expert must assess.

expected.summary: Questions for counsel are separate from the copied source.

key_facts.text: The practice note records questions, not professional advice.

steps.carries_forward: Add the questions under "Questions for counsel".

steps.title: Check the handoff
steps.goal: Keep an unsupported interpretation out of the source record.
steps.uses: renewal-terms.txt and the Renewal review note
steps.intro: An invented draft treats an assumption as if it were source wording.

challenge.task: A draft says the clause settles which delivery method is sufficient. Compare it with Section 2.1 in renewal-terms.txt and turn the interpretation into a question for counsel.
challenge.hint: Keep the clause unchanged and put uncertainty under Questions for counsel.
challenge.answer: The quoted clause does not settle a delivery method. Keep the source sentence intact and ask counsel what delivery requirements should be checked.

expected.summary: A reviewed handoff with source text separate from questions.

steps.carries_forward: Keep the reviewed question under "Questions for counsel".
self_check: Is the interpretation separated from plain text?
Does the handoff ask rather than decide?

troubleshooting.fix: Copy the expected key-fact wording back into the fictional practice source.

glossary.definition: A possible meaning to ask an expert about, distinct from quoted text.

disclaimer: Fictional practice exercise, not professional advice. All parties are fictional.
